title: Juicy Briny Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: A low-calorie Egyptian dish featuring lamb, grape nut cereal, and render-fat, perfect for a post-workout meal. The combination of feta cheese and grape nut cereal adds a briny and cheesy pull to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the crushed grape nut cereal over the lamb cubes.
Drizzle the render-fat over the grape nut cereal.
Top each skewer with a sprinkle of feta cheese.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
